title: Joint observation stage v2 through the topobathy chain (Grewingk box, full extent)
note: 2026-10-22 (TOPOBATHY_PLAN.md 'The joint observation stage'): every point and gridded source over the whole box goes through topobathy/joint.py (support, sigma from gridding loss, epoch, cross-check, over-water, pooled) and enters the composite as ONE layer, 'joint'; 3DEP is the prior (fallback only); the raster lidar DTMs without point clouds here (Seldovia 2019, Kenai 2008, Homer 2018/2019) stay raster layers with their class rules until they are brought into the joint stage. The water-bodies stage and the fill are unchanged.

layers.name: ctx3dep
layers.notes: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second fallback, shown only where no survey has a cell (the KBay point footprint counts as flown). water_3dep.tif (topobathy/flat_water.py, built by the chain): 3DEP's hydroflattened lakes as water, so a lake outside every survey gets a basin and 3DEP never stands as ground inside one.

layers.name: seldovia2019
layers.notes: USACE NCMP 2019 topobathy bare earth (Seldovia only); bed below MLLW, ground above; a bed cell > 1 m above the 2009 multibeam over 10 m, >= 100 m2, is kelp canopy.

layers.name: kenai2008
layers.notes: Kenai Peninsula 2008 lidar; its returns off the sea at the 2008 tide are water, not ground (Hig's v7 review). islets (2026-10-16, Bluff Point lump): specks of ground under 200 m2 ringed by water/void/bed are returns off the sea surface, classed water. 2026-10-18: water from the point cloud (topobathy/water_taught.py on observe_points.py cellstats: density, intensity, roughness, level, height above the local bottom; taught on mapped lakes, deep seabed and high ground; held-out lake precision 0.97, recall 0.90).

layers.name: homer2018
layers.notes: Homer 2018 NCMP green lidar: bed below MLLW, ground above; flat lakes with Hig's mapped prior. islets (2026-10-16, Bluff Point lump): specks of ground under 200 m2 ringed by water/void/bed are returns off the sea surface, classed water. flat_below (2026-10-16, Bluff Point): the green lidar returns the sea surface at its flight tide (-1.6..-0.5 m) as a smooth sheet, which below_level split into bed and ground; a flat sheet below 0 m NAVD88 is water, whether below_level called it bed or ground (so it runs after below_level, on every class). facets (2026-10-18): the vendor DTM bridges its data gaps with a TIN; cells planar to 2 cm over 10 m in patches of 200 m2 or more are "modelled", not ground (Beluga Lake south corner: Homer 2019 0.7-4 m above the 2018 surface across a gap).

layers.name: homer2019
layers.notes: Homer 2019 lidar: flat at the modal sea level = water; flat lakes with Hig's mapped prior. facets (2026-10-18): the vendor DTM bridges its data gaps with a TIN; cells planar to 2 cm over 10 m in patches of 200 m2 or more are "modelled", not ground (Beluga Lake south corner: Homer 2019 0.7-4 m above the 2018 surface across a gap).

layers.name: joint
layers.notes: topobathy/joint.py over the whole box at 2 m: KBay 2023 + Grewingk 2021 + Grewingk 2019 returns, the multibeam, BAGs, OCM, NCEI, CGOA, the SfM bare model and the Dixon ice as sources; layer_class codes ground/water/bed/ice/void.
layers.land_support_notes: joint.py: surveys with a surviving ground/bed cell (the berg rule counts surveys, not layers)

fill.notes: low_tide_m = MLLW in NAVD88 (-1.38 m). tidal_lens (default): marine domains take the observed water surface as the bed; measured beds (multibeam, green-lidar returns, the soundings export: Riordan 2018 KBSP lakes, Grewingk, Petrof and Gore 2022 (levels from 3DEP)) condition it.

water.notes: stage B as in the patches: bodies with kinds, the tidal lens, intertidal.tif anchored to observed ground. max_px 9100 (2026-10-17): the body stage at the grid's own 2 m for a 16 km box (+1 km margin = 9000 cells) -- at 4 m the pool bodies and the zone differed from the patches at their rims. max_px 12000 (2026-10-22): the full 23.5 km box at its own 2 m.

joint.notes: Sources for topobathy/joint.py. Lidar mosaics are joint_pilot.py mosaic output at 1 m over JOINT_WIN (bounds below); Grewingk 2021 carries its +0.36 m already (units stage). Soundings stay with the fill (per-survey offsets there). Epoch windows per class (joint.py DEFAULTS: ground 5 yr, bed 30 yr, ice 0.5 yr) and age sigma from the rates; a single pool_years here would override both (2026-10-22: it superseded the 2009 multibeam with the 2019 OCM merge).
